title: float(huge-int expires) raises OverflowError out of add_drop instead of clamping
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py:171. Bare float(value) with 10**400 input crashes add_drop; suppress(OverflowError) blocks cover only int() paths. Not wire-reachable (codec finite check gives 4.00) but direct/mesh callers crash rather than MAX_TTL clamp. Wrap or clamp.
close_reason: float(huge-int expires) no longer raises OverflowError out of add_drop/render_post paths: _numeric_value converts int/Decimal through guarded float(), returning +/-math.inf beyond float range; _extract_ttl's existing suppressed int() conversion then clamps +huge to DEADDROP_MAX_TTL and -huge to immediate expiry. Added regressions: 10**400 expires clamps to MAX_TTL (not default), -10**400 expires immediate-expiry, and wire-path huge-int remains 4.00 via codec finiteness validation. tests/coap -k deaddrop: 71 passed.
